LESSON: KUANDIKA 10.3.1 INSHA ZA MASIMULIZI

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Kuandika 10.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 10.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maudhui ya insha ya masimulizi ili kuandika ifaavyo
2. kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maudhui ya insha ya masimulizi ili kuandika ifaavyo
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maudhui ya insha ya masimulizi ili kuandika ifaavyo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 10.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 10.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 10.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 10.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maudhui ya insha ya masimulizi ili kuandika ifaavyo

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 10.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 10.3.1 Insha za Masimulizi important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maudhui ya insha ya masimulizi ili kuandika ifaavyo
2. kuandika insha ya masimulizi kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
